download.issue: figshare 'files' route: 140 of 474 tifs, 425 MB, flat 'files/' folder

image_findings: Four image types of mouse retina (RVO model): multicolour SLO fundus (#0,#3,#5), infrared SLO (#1), combined SLO+OCT side-by-side screenshots (#2,#4,#7: SLO thumbnail + B-scan), and fluorescein angiography (#6).
label_findings: submodality stays CANDIDATES {fluorescein angiography, fundus photography, near-infrared imaging, optical coherence tomography} (0% hard), body_part candidates {eye, retina}. The file name suffix token fully determines the type: '... Mcolor' -> fundus photography, '... IR' -> near-infrared imaging, '... FFA_NN' -> fluorescein angiography, '... OCT_NN' -> optical coherence tomography (OCT frames are SLO+OCT composites, label OCT).
metadata_findings: The file name stem (e.g. 'Laser_11 D7 IR') is not exposed as a metadata column: bids:suffix only fires when the stem contains '-', and this one uses spaces/underscores. So the decisive token is never matched. Needs a file-name-token column (path:name tokens), then overrides: Mcolor/IR/FFA/OCT.
fixes: pipeline: expose last file-name token (split on space/underscore) as path:suffix so overrides can map Mcolor/IR/FFA/OCT
labels: body_part multi [eye, retina]

Candidate submodality list lacks 'brightfield microscopy', so BF cannot be labelled even if resolved -> set both fields masked and use overrides, or fix the candidate list.
metadata_findings: path:d1 fluorescence_dataset/brightfield_dataset, path:d2 full_images/patches/..., path:d3 fluorescence/brightfield. Matcher: 'fluorescence' as a whole folder name is only a WEAK modality hit, so the column share (35 strong 'brightfield' of 70 = 50%) stays under COLUMN_MIN 0.6 and nothing is trusted; review.csv lists 'fluorescence' for modality.
fixes: labels: modality masked + submodality masked
overrides: path:d1/d2/d3 fluorescence/brightfield (see csv)
pipeline: treat exact folder/path tokens 'fluorescence' / 'brightfield' as strong

pipeline: FIELD_COLUMNS body_part regex needs word boundaries (r'(^|[^a-z])(organ|body|anatom|region|site|location|part|structure|tissue)')
